description: March 25 birthday meaning: Aries decan 1, birthday number 7, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a March 25 birthday falls in Aries, in the first decan, with Mars as the sign's ruler and Mars as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 7. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Aries is cardinal and fire.

sections.heading: Personality of a March 25 birthday
paragraphs: The 25th of March reduces to 7, numerology's thinker, set against the headlong first decan of Aries, around four degrees into the sign. The tension makes for an interesting temperament: someone courageous in the realm of ideas, who prefers to fight for truths they have worked out alone rather than for applause.

By noon UTC on March 25, the Sun has normally reached roughly 4° of Aries. That places the date in the Aries decan that astrologers give to Mars, the first of three. The opening stretch of Aries, from 0 to 9 degrees, is often called the purest expression of the sign, because Mars governs Aries and also acts as sub-ruler here. Astrologers traditionally picture this decan as the spark at the very start of the zodiac: quick to move, frank in speech and happiest with something to push against. The doubled Mars emphasis tends to sharpen courage and an appetite for challenge, and it can also shorten patience with slow processes. Many of these Rams recognise the urge to start before the plan is finished. Their growing edge is usually learning that a pause is not the same as a defeat.

sections.heading: Numerology of the March 25 birthday
paragraphs: Born on the 25th, your compound 2 + 5 reduces to 7. The 2's intuition and the 5's curiosity come together in the 7's reflective, analytical temperament. People born on the 25th are frequently described as perceptive, observant and drawn to understanding how things and people really work. They may test ideas through experience before trusting them. In its secondary role, the 25 is traditionally linked with a strong inner voice and a need for quiet time to process what they have gathered. Their insight often becomes valuable to others once they decide to share it.

Because the year enters the Life Path calculation, the same March 25 birthday leads to different paths across generations, among them 1 for 1980, 11 for 1990, 3 for 2000 and 4 for 2010. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11. The Life Path calculator does the reduction for any year.

sections.heading: March 25 in context: the season, Chinese zodiac and famous birthdays
paragraphs: A March birthday falls around the spring equinox for the northern hemisphere, the season of thaw and first growth, while southern birthdays mark the turn into autumn. The month is split between Pisces and Aries, with the change around March 20 or 21. In numerology March is month 3, linked with expression, creativity and sociability, a lively number for a month that ends with the zodiac starting over. March 25 is the 84th day of the year (85th in a leap year). In most years Taurus season is under way by April 20, 26 days after this birthday.

Chinese astrology is straightforward for a March 25 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies. March 25 is also the birthday of Elton John (1947), Aretha Franklin (1942) and Béla Bartók (1881).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is March 25?
faq.answer: March 25 is Aries in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the first decan of Aries, which tradition links with Mars.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on March 25?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On March 25 the Life Path is 8 in 1960, 9 in 1970, 1 in 1980, 11 in 1990, 3 in 2000, 4 in 2010 and 5 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 7 for everyone born on the 25th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on March 25?
faq.answer: By March 25 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on March 25?
faq.answer: Among the best-known people with a March 25 birthday are Elton John (1947), Aretha Franklin (1942) and Béla Bartók (1881). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
